vcu_g_0159_2000138c.name: motor_ramp_limit_scaled
vcu_g_0159_2000138c.description: Time-scaled limit byte: FUN_08001b46(elapsed, 3000, 6000, 40, 70) of motor_elapsed_ticks, computed in vcu_drive_command_update once the elapsed count passes 3000. It is then used to clamp the low byte of the output word 0x20001f96 (probably a derating limit that tightens over time). Its size is 1 because the next byte 0x2000138d is vehicle_ready_flag_a.

vcu_g_153_2000138c.name: motor_ramp_limit_scaled_b153
vcu_g_153_2000138c.description: Build 152/153 layout of motor_ramp_limit_scaled. Same computation and use in vcu_drive_command_update, one byte.

vcu_g_0159_2000139e.name: motor_output_limit
vcu_g_0159_2000139e.description: Target output limit, 0..255, recomputed each tick by vcu_drive_command_update from the drive mode (1..4) and the derating values. The output word low byte 0x20001f94 is brought toward this value through the ramp (motor_ramp_tick and motor_ramp_step).

vcu_g_14a_2000139e.name: motor_output_limit_b14a
vcu_g_14a_2000139e.description: Build 148/14a layout of motor_output_limit. Same byte and use in vcu_drive_command_update, at a different address in these builds.

vcu_g_0159_2000139f.name: motor_ramp_enable
vcu_g_0159_2000139f.description: Ramp gate, 0 or 1, set every tick by vcu_drive_command_update from the speed-like value 0x20001f4c, flag 0x20001f4f and bit 2 of 0x20001f78. When it is 0 the output low byte is the idle value motor_idle_output. When it is 1 and 0x20001f4c is above 50, the ramp runs.

vcu_g_14f_2000139f.name: motor_ramp_enable_b14f
vcu_g_14f_2000139f.description: Build 148..14f layout of motor_ramp_enable. Same flag and use in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_153_2000139f.name: motor_ramp_enable_b153
vcu_g_153_2000139f.description: Build 152/153 layout of motor_ramp_enable. Same flag and use in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_0159_200013a0.name: motor_ramp_tick
vcu_g_0159_200013a0.description: Tick counter of the output ramp in vcu_drive_command_update. It increments while the output is below motor_output_limit. When it passes motor_ramp_limit it resets to 0 and the output low byte 0x20001f94 rises by motor_ramp_step.

vcu_g_14f_200013a0.name: motor_ramp_tick_b14f
vcu_g_14f_200013a0.description: Build 148..14f layout of motor_ramp_tick. Same counter and use in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_153_200013a0.name: motor_ramp_tick_b153
vcu_g_153_200013a0.description: Build 152/153 layout of motor_ramp_tick. Same counter and use in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_0159_200013a1.name: motor_ramp_step
vcu_g_0159_200013a1.description: Amount added to the output low byte 0x20001f94 each time the ramp tick passes motor_ramp_limit. It is set to 1 by vcu_drive_command_update when the ramp gate motor_ramp_enable is cleared.

vcu_g_14f_200013a1.name: motor_ramp_step_b14f
vcu_g_14f_200013a1.description: Build 148..14f layout of motor_ramp_step. Same step value and use in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_153_200013a1.name: motor_ramp_step_b153
vcu_g_153_200013a1.description: Build 152/153 layout of motor_ramp_step. Same step value and use in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_0159_200013a2.name: motor_level_setpoint_last
vcu_g_0159_200013a2.description: Snapshot of the level setpoint motor_level_setpoint (probably u16). vcu_drive_command_update compares them each tick. On a change it copies the new value here and recomputes motor_setpoint_scaled. vcu_0159_080047ac clears it.

vcu_g_14f_200013a2.name: motor_level_setpoint_last_b14f
vcu_g_14f_200013a2.description: Build 148..14f layout of motor_level_setpoint_last. Same snapshot and use in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_14b_200013a4.name: motor_drive_state_b14b
vcu_g_14b_200013a4.description: Build-14b-only byte in the drive state block. vcu_0159_080047ac writes it and vcu_drive_command_update reads and writes it through a base pointer. Its meaning is not established.

vcu_g_0159_200013b6.name: motor_ramp_limit
vcu_g_0159_200013b6.description: Ramp threshold for motor_ramp_tick, set per drive mode in vcu_drive_command_update to one of 8, 10, 12, 14 or 16. A larger value means each ramp step takes more ticks.

vcu_g_0159_200013b8.name: motor_idle_output
vcu_g_0159_200013b8.description: Idle output value, 10 in every drive mode branch. It is copied to the low byte of 0x20001f94 when the ramp gate motor_ramp_enable is 0.

vcu_g_153_200013b8.name: motor_idle_output_b153
vcu_g_153_200013b8.description: Build 152/153 layout of motor_idle_output. Same value and use in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_0159_200013ba.name: motor_duty_ramp
vcu_g_0159_200013ba.description: Slew-limited duty value, 0..128. It moves one step toward a target computed from 0x20001e62 by FUN_0800f050, about once every 500 ticks (motor_slew_divider). vcu_drive_command_update multiplies it into the output word 0x20001f9a. It is capped at 0x80.

vcu_g_0159_200013bc.name: motor_slew_divider
vcu_g_0159_200013bc.description: Tick divider for motor_duty_ramp. It increments each call; when it passes 500 it resets to 0 and allows one duty step.

vcu_g_0159_200013be.name: motor_elapsed_ticks
vcu_g_0159_200013be.description: Elapsed-tick counter of the drive timing. It counts up each tick in vcu_drive_command_update. Past 3001 it also feeds motor_ramp_limit_scaled, and it resets to 0 after passing 5999 or when motor_low_state_timer expires.

vcu_g_153_200013be.name: motor_elapsed_ticks_b153
vcu_g_153_200013be.description: Build 152/153 layout of motor_elapsed_ticks. Same counter and use in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_0159_200013c0.name: motor_low_state_timer
vcu_g_0159_200013c0.description: 500-tick timeout counter. It counts while 0x20001f88 is below 70, and when it passes 500 it resets itself and motor_elapsed_ticks (probably a stall or low-speed timeout).

vcu_g_14f_200013c0.name: motor_low_state_timer_b14f
vcu_g_14f_200013c0.description: Build 148..14f layout of motor_low_state_timer. Same timeout and use in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_153_200013c0.name: motor_low_state_timer_b153
vcu_g_153_200013c0.description: Build 152/153 layout of motor_low_state_timer. Same timeout and use in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_14f_200013c2.name: motor_drive_state_b14f_13c2
vcu_g_14f_200013c2.description: Build 148..14f byte in the drive state block, read and written by vcu_drive_command_update through a base pointer. Its meaning is not established.

vcu_g_0159_200013c6.name: motor_model_code_copy
vcu_g_0159_200013c6.description: Four-byte copy of the four characters at 0x20001ad9, which are part of the 14-character serial_string (data_app_batch02). vcu_drive_command_update copies them each tick and compares the two 16-bit halves as ASCII digit pairs (for example 0x3532 is "25") to choose the drive profile flag 0x20001fdb. The upper half, family 0159 200013c8, is inside this object.

vcu_g_153_200013d0.name: motor_mode_table_b153
vcu_g_153_200013d0.description: Build 152/153 layout of motor_mode_table, shifted 12 bytes lower. Per profile row (0x30 bytes, selected by 0x20001fa5), four drive modes each have two words. The words are passed to FUN_08001256 and FUN_080012ba (probably f32 or u32 setpoints).

vcu_g_0159_200013dc.name: motor_mode_table
vcu_g_0159_200013dc.description: Per-profile table used by vcu_drive_command_update. Each row is 0x30 bytes, selected by the profile index 0x20001fa5. Four drive modes (0x20001b68 - 1) each have two u32 words at +8*mode (first word at 0x200013dc, second at 0x200013e0), and the mode-3 slot is overwritten from motor_index_pair_a/b or motor_row_pair_a. The words are probably f32 setpoints, passed to FUN_08001256 and FUN_080012ba.

vcu_g_153_20001430.name: motor_pair_b153_1430
vcu_g_153_20001430.description: Build 152/153 word pair at 0x20001430..0x20001437, reached only through a base pointer in vcu_drive_command_update. It is probably one entry of a per-index table like motor_index_pair_a. The meaning is not established.

vcu_g_0159_2000143c.name: motor_index_pair_a
vcu_g_0159_2000143c.description: Word pair of a table indexed by motor_profile_index - 1, with stride 8. In drive mode 3, when the profile 0x20001fa7 is 0 or 3, vcu_drive_command_update copies the first word to 0x200013ec + row and the second word (0x20001440) to 0x200013f0 + row.

vcu_g_153_20001448.name: motor_pair_b153_1448
vcu_g_153_20001448.description: Build 152/153 word pair at 0x20001448..0x2000144f, reached only through a base pointer in vcu_drive_command_update. It is probably the build-152/153 counterpart of motor_index_pair_a. The meaning is not established.

vcu_g_153_20001450.name: motor_word_b153_1450
vcu_g_153_20001450.description: Build 152/153 word at 0x20001450, reached only through a base pointer in vcu_drive_command_update. The meaning is not established.

vcu_g_0159_20001454.name: motor_row_pair_a
vcu_g_0159_20001454.description: Per-profile word pair with stride 0x20, selected by 0x20001fa5. When flag 0x20001f92 bit 7 is set in drive mode 3, vcu_drive_command_update copies the first word (0x20001454) and the second word (0x20001458) into the mode-3 slots of the row of motor_mode_table.

vcu_g_153_20001454.name: motor_row_word_b153_1454
vcu_g_153_20001454.description: Build 152/153 word at 0x20001454, with the same stride-0x20 profile indexing as motor_row_pair_a and the same copy in drive mode 3. The meaning is probably the same as motor_row_pair_a.

vcu_g_0159_2000145c.name: motor_index_pair_b
vcu_g_0159_2000145c.description: Second word pair of the table indexed by motor_profile_index - 1, stride 8. In drive mode 3 with profile 0x20001fa7 not 0 or 3, vcu_drive_command_update copies its words (0x2000145c and 0x20001460) into the mode-3 slots of the row of motor_mode_table.

vcu_g_14f_20001a9a.name: motor_variant_cfg_a_b14f
vcu_g_14f_20001a9a.description: Configuration word of the build 148..14f layout, read by vcu_drive_command_update and loaded with defaults by vcu_0159_08009da8. It is probably a variant or option word; the meaning is not established.

vcu_g_14f_20001a9c.name: motor_variant_cfg_b_b14f
vcu_g_14f_20001a9c.description: Second configuration word of the build 148..14f layout, read by vcu_drive_command_update and loaded with defaults by vcu_0159_08009da8. It is probably a variant or option word; the meaning is not established.

vcu_g_153_20001b42.name: motor_mode_limit_a_b153
vcu_g_153_20001b42.description: Build 152/153 word holding two per-mode limits. The low byte is the limit for drive mode 1 and the high byte is the limit for drive mode 2, both read and rewritten by vcu_drive_command_update. vcu_0159_08009da8 also writes it.

vcu_g_153_20001b44.name: motor_mode_limit_b_b153
vcu_g_153_20001b44.description: Build 152/153 word whose high byte is the limit for drive mode 3, read and rewritten by vcu_drive_command_update. vcu_0159_08009da8 initialises it to 0x2020 (32, 32).

vcu_g_0159_20001b46.name: motor_level_setpoint
vcu_g_0159_20001b46.description: Level setpoint, 0..30 (probably the rider or host power request). The default is 5, set by vcu_runtime_defaults_init and vcu_0159_08009da8. vcu_drive_command_update clamps it to 0x1e (30). A change is recorded in motor_level_setpoint_last and rescales motor_setpoint_scaled.

vcu_g_153_20001b46.name: motor_level_setpoint_b153
vcu_g_153_20001b46.description: Build 152/153 layout of motor_level_setpoint. Same setpoint, default and clamp in vcu_drive_command_update.

vcu_g_0159_20001b90.name: motor_profile_index
vcu_g_0159_20001b90.description: Index (1 or 2, default 2) into the stride-8 tables motor_index_pair_a and motor_index_pair_b, used as (value - 1) * 8. vcu_0159_08009da8 replaces 0 with 2.

vcu_g_0159_20001b9c.name: motor_timeout_select
vcu_g_0159_20001b9c.description: Selector for the timeout limit motor_timeout_limit: 0 gives 30, 1 gives 15 and 2 gives 5. The default is 1, set by vcu_runtime_defaults_init.

vcu_g_14f_20001f2d.name: motor_state_b14f
vcu_g_14f_20001f2d.description: Build 148..14f byte in the drive state. vcu_0159_080047ac reads it and vcu_drive_command_update writes it through a pointer. The meaning is not established.

vcu_g_0159_20001f9a.name: motor_output_duty
vcu_g_0159_20001f9a.description: Output word. Its low byte is the output value 0..255, computed as (motor_duty_ramp times the mode limit) >> 6, or set to 0x14 (20) when the derate path is active. can_get_tx_payload_for_id copies that low byte into payload byte 2 of frame 0x20c.

vcu_g_0159_20001f8e.name: motor_tx_word_184
vcu_g_0159_20001f8e.description: 16-bit field of CAN frame 0x184. vcu_drive_command_update sets it each tick from FUN_080012ee() (probably a measured value) or from the override at 0x200020a6. can_get_tx_payload_for_id places it in payload bytes 4 and 5. The byte at 0x20001f8c is a separate field (vehicle_state_word_f8c, data_vehicle_batch30).
